scenes.narration: A semicolon in the wrong place can change what your program does.
scenes.caption: One small character

scenes.narration: After the condition's closing parenthesis, a semicolon creates an empty if body. The next block runs independently.
scenes.caption: An empty body

scenes.narration: Remove that semicolon, attach the block to the condition, and test both true and false cases.
scenes.caption: Attach the block
